title: 12 Corfu Wedding Venues With Sea Views
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: NEW venue guide (not a refresh). Title '12 Corfu Wedding Venues With Sea Views'. Model: content/posts/crete-wedding-venues: every venue verified on its own official site; house rules not published written as 'Not published' with an Advisor line once per area, no VERIFY marker, listed on a booking checklist; no prices or fees. INCLUSION RULE: the venue's own site says it hosts weddings AND its own site states a sea view for the wedding spaces or the property (never inferred from photos). Reuse Corfu Imperial and Angsana Corfu facts from content/posts/greece-wedding-venues/03-source-pack*.json and content/posts/greece-wedding-packages/03-source-pack*.json, re-checked live, fresh wording.

OVERLAP: link map has no Corfu pages. SEO checks whether any site page (including /destinations/europe/greece) ranks for 'corfu wedding venues' and variants (corfu wedding, getting married in corfu, corfu wedding villa, corfu beach wedding, wedding venues corfu greece). Link the Greece venues guide and Greece packages guide (drafts) both ways, the Greece hub, and /expert-advice/greek-wedding-traditions once.

AUTHORITY RULE (content-system/brand/voice-guide.md 'Write with authority'): no research talk in the copy (what we could or couldn't find, trace or confirm; our sources or method; what the internet says; myths sections; 'you will often read'). Customs without a strong source are written as living practice in a confident voice ('Many couples...'), never with a meaning or origin stated as fact. 'Often told' at most once per post, never 'it is often told that'. No hedge stacking: cite a source once by link; date legal and travel facts once per section. Source gaps go in the run report only. No per-line source credits (never 'Britannica describes', 'the museum holds', 'the study records'). No myth-busting lines ('you will often read', 'confident dates').

Venue selection (brief sets 12 plus reserves): spread across Kommeno and Dassia (north of Corfu Town), Corfu Town, the north-east (Kassiopi, Agni, Kalami), the west coast (Paleokastritsa, Glyfada, Agios Gordios), the south (Benitses, Moraitika). Corfu proper only (no Paxos). Mix of luxury resorts, historic venues and estates, private villas with exclusive use. Unconfirmable candidates are swapped; do not pad to 12 (if fewer qualify, the title count changes and the person is told).

Each venue entry, from official pages only: location and setting; the sea view in the venue's own words; ceremony options (only as stated); capacity, rooms and exclusive use where published, else 'Not published'; one standout detail.

Supporting sections (short, sourced): at-a-glance table; choosing an area (east vs west coast, only as official tourism or venues state it); getting there (Corfu airport, official sources); season (Hellenic National Meteorological Service averages for Corfu, Smartraveller heat and wildfire); legal in brief (Embassy Athens and Smartraveller facts re-checked, as at November 2026, link the Greece guide's legal section).

Sources: venues' official sites and wedding pages, visitgreece.gr, the Corfu airport's official site, hnms.gr, Smartraveller, the Australian Embassy Athens. Never competitor wedding sites, directories, planner blogs, review sites or Wikipedia.
Images: placeholders only; every venue image licensed or from a venue press kit with permission; never AI for a venue, destination or wedding; competitor images reference-only.

Speed: Apify web-fetch and DataForSEO. Fact-check as 3 parallel batches (A: Kommeno, Dassia, Corfu Town incl. Corfu Imperial, fact_01+; B: north-east and south incl. Angsana, fact_100+; C: west coast plus season, airport and legal, fact_200+), 15 min HARD by the clock, no new reads after the limit, save after every 3 facts, scratch folders cfu_a/cfu_b/cfu_c; a top-up batch (cfu_d, fact_300+) if fewer than 12 qualify; self_qa.confidence a number; must_include_coverage objects with covered_by arrays; never retry a declined call.
Headings must not contain pasted keywords in brackets.

Do not use 'from first idea to the last dance' or 'last dance'; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; nothing on legal, church or religious paperwork; no transfer arrangements; no Wedded Privileges.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices or amounts; venue names allowed, no other vendor names; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
